name: Cell to Singularity: Mesozoic Valley 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Cell to Singularity: Mesozoic Valley is a clicker science-based idle game where you get to delve into the prehistoric world of dinosaurs. Uncover hidden fossils and construct your own Jurassic simulation as you complete missions to earn fossil points, unlocking a diverse array of unique dinosaur species.
